thread:
lara: Heads-up — Prism (dedicated tenant) cutover scheduled TOMORROW 2026-03-21 02:00-03:00 UTC. Asking for final sign-offs. We'll pin model/service to v2.4.1-rc2 and run staged canaries 5% -> 25% -> full.

devon: Ack. I'm on pinning and preflight checks. Will post checklist.

manny: I added the tenant test fixtures to the staging slice, can run a smoke ahead of the window.

deploy-bot: [deploy queued] prism-tenant v2.4.1-rc2 -> reserved-dedicated-42. Canary slices: 5% (slice-a). Triggered by user lara at 2026-03-20T18:15Z.

lara: @devon please confirm rollback thresholds we want enforced in the rollout policy. My suggestion: error-rate > 2% (5m) OR p95 latency increase > 30% vs baseline (10m) -> automatic rollback to previous stable (v2.4.0).

devon: +1 to the thresholds. Also add a soft hold if CPU util > 80% across all nodes for 3 consecutive minutes.

elaine: Release notes draft: "Prism performance improvements + improved KV cache invalidation. Note: minor behavioral change in reranking results — see QA notes." Link: https://internal.docs/release-notes/prism/v2.4.1-rc2

pm-zoe: I'm OK with the window. FYI PM sign-off from customer (Prism Ops) received at 2026-03-20 16:40 UTC. They asked for a 30-min rollback hold after canary.

sre-oncall: I'll be on watch. I'll attach runbook and set up dashboard alerts: errors, p95, GPU mem pressure. Paging policy: page @sre-oncall -> primary then infra-rotate.

manny: Quick verification command I'll run during window:
```
# smoke: 50 requests sampling tenant keys
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwoodinference.internal/prism/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}'
```

devon: Done: pinned prism-tenant -> v2.4.1-rc2 at config:tenant/prism/active_version = "v2.4.1-rc2". Also uploaded canary dataset slice-a.

deploy-bot: [canary start] 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z - slice-a (5%). Routing policy: latency-first. Canary policy: monitor errors/p95/cpu for 10m baseline.

lara: If canary passes, proceed 5% -> 25% over 15m ramp. Auto-rollback on thresholds above. If any manual abort, route traffic back to v2.4.0 and run postmortem.

sre-oncall: I'll be in the channel at cutover. Posting dashboard link: https://observability.internal/dashboards/prism-canary

deploy-bot: [canary update] 2026-03-21T02:10:00Z - slice-a health: errors 0.6% (ok), p95 latency +12% (ok), cpu 64% (ok). Continuing.

deploy-bot: [canary update] 2026-03-21T02:25:00Z - canary 25% rollout started.

deploy-bot: [canary update] 2026-03-21T02:35:00Z - canary 25% stable. metrics: errors 0.9%, p95 +18%, gpu mem 38%.

elaine: Posting customer-facing release note link in support ticket and SSO email.

pm-zoe: Customer acknowledged successful roll to 25% and asked to proceed to full after 30m.

deploy-bot: [finalizing] 2026-03-21T03:00:00Z - full rollout in progress.

deploy-bot: [deployed] 2026-03-21T03:05:00Z - prism-tenant v2.4.1-rc2 -> active. No automatic rollback triggered.

lara: Thanks everyone. Postmortem: light monitoring only; only keep docs/rollback-notes updated if we need follow-up.

manny: I'll run extended perf tests tonight and open any follow-ups as issues in #eng-runtime.

sre-oncall: Closing watch. No incidents.

devon: I'll cut the formal release tag and add to changelog.

deploy-bot: [audit] rollout 2123456789 completed by lara. Audit ID: r-8f3d2b.
